context: Tests whether the agent correctly implements Interactive mode: using AskUserQuestion for each finding with the three valid options (fix as suggested, skip with reason, fix differently), and distinguishing interactive mode from automatic mode behavior.

checklist.name: AskUserQuestion per finding
checklist.description: AskUserQuestion is called (or documented as the mechanism) for each individual finding in the interactive workflow, not just once at the start

checklist.name: Fix as suggested option
checklist.description: Each per-finding prompt includes an option to 'Fix (as suggested)' or equivalent phrasing

checklist.name: Skip with reason option
checklist.description: Each per-finding prompt includes an option to 'Skip (with reason)' or equivalent phrasing

checklist.name: Fix differently option
checklist.description: Each per-finding prompt includes a third option allowing the user to describe an alternative fix

checklist.name: No pre-emptive summary table
checklist.description: In Interactive mode, the agent does NOT show a bulk 'Fixing N / Skipping M' summary table before asking — it handles findings one at a time

checklist.name: Stop after each iteration
checklist.description: In Interactive mode, after completing an iteration the agent asks the user whether to continue or stop before starting the next iteration

checklist.name: state.json updated
checklist.description: state.json is updated after processing all findings: fixed items go into the 'fixed' array, skipped items into the 'skipped' array

checklist.name: Mode selection prompt
checklist.description: The workflow documents or uses AskUserQuestion to ask the user to choose between Automatic and Interactive mode at the start

checklist.name: Findings in state.json
checklist.description: The 'findings' array in state.json is populated with the findings parsed from the review output

checklist.name: Interactive vs auto distinction
checklist.description: The implementation clearly distinguishes Interactive behavior (per-finding prompts) from Automatic behavior (bulk decision + summary table)
